content: Persistent multiplayer game state consensus (2026 sources): PostgreSQL is the source of truth for durable game state (session rows, scheduled actions like builds/raids must resolve correctly even when player offline), Redis is a fast read cache / coordination layer / short-lived counters where losing state is tolerable. Timestamp-derived state (store when an event is due, scan for due rows) survives restarts naturally; periodic tick scanning due rows with row claiming is preferred over per-entity delayed jobs that cannot be cancelled and create job sprawl.
